patch_description: Restructure the packer into three vectorized stages: (1) LPT greedy packing approximated by a tensorized batched-heap sweep (repeat interleave of loads), (2) full vectorized multi-pair swap refinement that resolves the best swap between the heaviest and lightest packs across all layers simultaneously (replacing sequential single-swap rounds), and (3) a cheap pairwise-match pass pairing the heaviest remaining item with the lightest pack item set. All stages remain loop-free over layers and reuse the validated scatter-based index construction from the snake packer, so the packing stays O(1) Python passes regardless of layer count while achieving better balance than pure snake ordering.
